guidance.multipleChoice: Choose one best answer. Read every option before you submit.
guidance.trueFalse: Read the statement carefully. Pick True if it is correct, or False if it is not correct.
guidance.shortAnswer: Write 1-2 clear sentences. Use key words from the lesson to explain your thinking.
guidance.multipleSelect: Select every answer that applies. More than one option can be correct.
guidance.matching: Match each item with its correct partner from the list.
guidance.ordering: Put all of the steps in the correct order before you submit.
guidance.fillInBlank: Type one word or a short phrase in each blank.
guidance.numericResponse: Write the number and the unit exactly as the question asks.
